intelligence.enrichment: Soil contains things such as sand, insects, worms, small organisms, and decayed plants and animals. Soil forms when rocks break apart through actions of the Sun, water, and living organisms over thousands of years. Long-term breaking apart of rocks, together with living and decaying organisms, produces soil with varied contents and textures. The learner correctly applies this rule: Soil contains things such as sand, insects, worms, small organisms, and decayed plants and animals. Soil forms when rocks break apart through actions of the Sun, water, and living organisms over thousands of years. Soil is just loose dirt and forms quickly from decayed leaves.
